## model.config_overrides (MODEL_CONFIG keys)

`default` = MODEL_CONFIG; `with anti_memorization` = the value in force under the default `model.anti_memorization=True`. Overrides win over both.

## Registered names

| registry | names | used by |
|---|---|---|
| `trainer.TASK_REGISTRY` | `classification`, `evidential`, `regression` | trainer config tasks (regression / evidential / classification) |
| `model.HEAD_REGISTRY` | `binary_classification`, `multiclass_classification` | model.config_overrides.head_types entries registered here (nig_regression is built in) |
| `data.NORMALIZERS` | `logret_sigma`, `logret_std`, `window_scale` | project.config_overrides.price_norm_mode (plus the built-in 'pct_change') |
| `data.SAMPLE_FILTER_REGISTRY` | (none) | project.config_overrides.sample_filters {'fn': name} (none registered by default) |
| `data.PRICE_NORM_MODES` | `window_scale`, `pct_change`, `logret_std`, `logret_sigma` | project.config_overrides.price_norm_mode |
| `core.schema.TARGET_MODES` | `return`, `return_close`, `scaled`, `magnitude`, `volnorm`, `entry_range` | target.target_mode (optionally '+relative') |
| `core.schema.ENTRY_CLOSE_REGS` | `abs_return`, `range_pos` | target.entry_close_reg |

## Looked at and not enabled in recommended_2026_11

| option | reason |
|---|---|
| target.target_mode | relative / cross-sectional targets closed at economics: F-0031, F-0033; E-rel-001 not run and waits for the owner's decision on absolute vs relative; logret_std refuses non-default target modes |
| model.class_only | classification-only heads: the direction/classification heads failed (F-0001, F-0085); the confidence and NIG heads are what the recommended run measures |
| project.config_overrides.sample_filters / features (rel_volume, zero_vol_share_w, min_liquidity_30d) | E-liq-001 is pre-registered but its components are not built yet; gate-style features closed (F-0080, F-0081) |
| project.config_overrides.price_norm_mode='logret_sigma' | refuses regression heads (raises by design, E-norm-001) |
| evaluation.mn_quantiles / mn_universe | no result favours other values; defaults kept |
| train.batch_size / epochs / early_stopping_patience / lambda_reg / lambda_calib | changing step size or schedules is a training experiment that needs its own card (hardening/profile_2026-11.md item 4, MODEL_DEV_PROTOCOL); not part of this preset |
| train.seed | a run parameter, not a recommendation: one run is one seed; the protocol needs >= 3 seeds per arm |
| panel.* | the cross-asset panel model closed for 1d (F-0035); disabled by default and not part of this run |
| data.* (filename_base, model_tfs, split_dates, path, ...) | which dataset to load is the owner's; the preset only checks the options the dataset must have been built with (dataset_mismatches) |
| PREDICT_BATCH_SIZE (core.schema) and rf_max_samples (evaluation.patterns) | not RunSettings fields; D-013 makes 2048 and 50 000 the defaults when PR #62 is merged, so nothing to set here |
| research/natr_range E-natr-004 (rolling recalibration of the NATR range band) | a separate study with its own tool (tools/natr_range.py), not a RunSettings option; Stage B waits for forward data (not before 2027-01-01) |

## Conflicts between choices

| between | resolution |
|---|---|
| model.config_overrides.use_instance_norm=False (E-norm-002, new) vs model.anti_memorization=True (proven; its config sets use_instance_norm=True) | both kept: anti_memorization is a bundle (small model, noise, EMA, level_passthrough) whose evidence is about the bundle on window_scale inputs; E-norm-002 changes the one key and its card names AM + logret_std as arm A. config_overrides win over AM by design (workflow.run.plan_model) |
| target.suspended_targets=() (D-013, new) vs closed finding: close direction has no signal (F-0001, T4) | kept by owner decision D-013 (market_neutral needs p_up_close; M3 measures high/low with and without close); the close head is trained, nothing is claimed about its direction |
| price_norm_mode='logret_std' (new) vs dataset already built with another mode | hazard, not a choice: the loaded file decides; dataset_mismatches(settings, dataset) lists it and the run folder suffix keeps models apart |
